title: Ably Error Codes
description: The registry of Ably error codes, generated from errors/codes/*.md in ably-common.

_comment.description: Note that this file is generated; not part of the data.

codes.description: A map of error code to its definition.

identifier.description: A stable snake_case name for the code, the canonical basis for the constant each SDK generates.

title.description: A short human-readable title for the error.

summary.description: A one or two sentence plain-language summary of the error.
